params.prompt:
One continuous fixed-camera close-up in the exact workshop and camera setup of the reference image. Same older woman, gray hair loosely tied back, tan work shirt, small earrings, same blue shoulder of the seated buyer at right edge if visible. She keeps her eyes screen-right toward him, not toward camera. Her initial expression is comfortable and ready to answer, not worried yet.

One primary action: she begins an answer and interrupts herself. For about the first second hold her raised gaze and ordinary confidence. Then she begins a brief natural answer with restrained conversational mouth movement and a very small explanatory gesture only if a hand naturally enters the bottom of the frame. Keep her gaze up and her answer continuing until approximately 5.5 seconds. Between roughly 5.5 and 6.5 seconds, she stops herself: her mouth closes, any unfinished hand gesture settles, and her gaze lowers slightly as she considers what she cannot finish saying. Hold that quiet, unresolved consideration for the remaining seconds. Do not start her gaze drop early. No second answer, smile recovery, theatrical sadness, gasp, repeated nodding, head shaking or resolving sigh.

Silent narrated dramatization, illustrative conversational movement only; no audible character voice or invented exact words. Preserve her exact face, clothes, posture, soft daylight and workshop texture. The man remains quiet at frame edge. She never draws, writes, picks up a page or touches a new object. Camera and lens stay fixed: no zoom, push-in, pan, orbit, cuts, slow motion or focus gimmick. No new props or yellow paper artifact. Finish on her still considering, with eyes gently lowered and mouth closed, not looking back up.
